_meta.purpose: Tier-1 routing eval seed — asserts WHICH skill a question should trigger, given only the 6 frontmatter descriptions. This is the one dimension no static check covers (verify-skills.mjs validates param NAMES, not which description wins) and the only net for the semantically-wrong/schema-valid class (e.g. event_playbook family='Wedding') that passes every static gate and fails live.
_meta.expectedSkillValues: one of the 6 skill folder names, or 'out-of-scope' for questions no skill should own (margin/pricing-strategy).
_meta.grows: This is a SEED (~24). The full golden set targets the ~106 #ask-evwa questions (taxonomy in the private mcp-gateway 2026-05-23-evwa-v0-analysis.md); ~60-70 are recoverable by re-extraction — a Batch-2 first task.
_meta.seededNegatives: The three cases below tagged "negative": true are the hiccups-hunt collisions — each is a question a sibling skill plausibly grabs but must NOT. They are the regression guard for the front-loaded descriptions.
